texts: Dr. Amara Osei is a senior cardiologist at Addis General Hospital. She has been working there for twelve years and is known for her expertise in heart failure management. Patients under Dr. Osei's care have a significantly lower readmission rate compared to the national average. The hospital administration considers her one of its top-performing staff members.
notes: Dense paragraph — multiple entities, roles, relationships, and institutional rules mixed together

texts: Zenith Logistics operates a regional distribution network across East Africa. Its main warehouse is located in Nairobi and managed by a supervisor named Kofi Mensah. Every shipment that arrives at the warehouse is inspected by the quality control team before being forwarded to retail partners. If a shipment fails inspection, it is quarantined and a report is sent to the supplier. Last Tuesday, a shipment of electronics from Shenzhen Tech Ltd arrived with damaged packaging. The quality control team flagged it as non-compliant. As a result, the shipment was quarantined and Shenzhen Tech Ltd received a formal defect notice. Kofi Mensah escalated the case to the regional director, Fatima Al-Rashid, who authorized a replacement order.
notes: Business process paragraph — conditional rules, events, and multi-hop escalation chain

texts: The Rift Valley ecosystem supports a complex food web. Acacia trees produce seed pods that are consumed by giraffes. Giraffes are prey for lions when they are young or injured. Lions are apex predators and regulate the population of herbivores. When herbivore populations are controlled, vegetation recovers more quickly after drought. The 2022 drought severely reduced the acacia canopy in the southern sector. Rangers from the Rift Valley Conservation Authority observed that giraffe numbers in that sector dropped by thirty percent over eighteen months. A decline in giraffes reduces the food availability for lions, which then expand their territory northward into areas closer to human settlements.
notes: Ecology paragraph — 3-hop causal chain from drought to human-wildlife conflict

texts: Under the service agreement signed on 14 January 2024 between Orion Software Solutions and Bole Tech Park, Orion is obligated to deliver a fully functional inventory management system within ninety days of contract execution. The agreement further stipulates that any delay beyond the deadline incurs a penalty of two percent of the contract value per week. Orion's lead developer, Samuel Girma, reported on 10 April that the core module was complete but the reporting dashboard required an additional three weeks of work. Since the ninety-day deadline fell on 14 April, the dashboard delay places Orion in breach of contract. Bole Tech Park's legal team, led by Counsel Hana Tesfaye, has been notified and is reviewing options including invoking the penalty clause.
notes: Legal/contractual paragraph — obligations, deadlines, breach conditions, and named parties

texts: The Computational Neuroscience Lab at Addis Ababa University is led by Professor Yonas Haile. The lab currently has eight PhD students and three postdoctoral researchers. Its primary research focus is on spiking neural network models for sensory processing. The lab collaborates with the OpenCog Foundation on integrating neural models with symbolic reasoning systems. Dr. Liya Tadesse, a postdoc in the lab, recently published a paper demonstrating that sparse coding in spiking networks reduces energy consumption by forty percent compared to dense activation models. The paper was accepted at NeurIPS 2024. Professor Haile stated that the lab plans to extend this work to auditory cortex models in the next funding cycle.
notes: Academic paragraph — people, institutions, research topics, and publication facts

texts: Addis Ababa's light rail transit system, operated by the Ethiopian Railways Corporation, connects the eastern suburb of Ayat to the western terminus at Torhailoch. The system carries an average of 60,000 passengers per day. Maintenance of the rolling stock is contracted to a Chinese firm, CRRC Corporation, under a ten-year agreement. In February 2025, a power substation failure near Megenagna station caused service disruptions for three days. The Ethiopian Electric Power authority dispatched a repair team within six hours of the fault being reported. Commuters affected by the outage were redirected to feeder bus routes managed by Anbessa City Bus Service. The disruption highlighted the dependency of the rail system on a single power feed from the national grid.
notes: Infrastructure paragraph — system components, dependencies, events, and organizations
